Dr. Althea - 147 Barrier Cream

Korean Skincare

250 MAD

If barrier repair is your goal, Dr. Althea 147 Barrier Cream deserves a spot in your barrier recovery routine. This soothing moisturizer works to strengthen a weakened skin barrier while replenishing moisture and resilience to dry, rough or sensitive skin. It delivers multilayered hydration and nourishment with ectoin, guaiazulene, ceramide NP and seven types of hyaluronic acid. The vegan, fragrance-free formula features aloe vera leaf water and various botanical extracts to keep skin feeling calm, comfortable and balanced. Your skin barrier will thank you. What we love most: Dr. Althea 147 Barrier Cream performs heavy-duty daily barrier care while staying refreshingly lightweight.
